Nadia: Quick poll: what's your comfort midnight snack? keep it weird. :popcorn:
Eli: Cold pizza, always. crust is a fork substitute. :pizza:
Cam: Grapes. feel fancy and lazy. :grapes:
Tomas: Peanut butter straight out of the jar. zero shame. :peanuts:
Nadia: vote option: sweet, savory, fruit, ritual (tea+book). react with :one: :two: :three: :four:
Eli: :two: but with a side of nostalgia. french fries at midnight are unbeatable.
Cam: :three: grapes for the win. also: dunking grapes in yogurt is illegal in some countries.
plants-bot: Tip: sandwich your snack with a glass of water for balance. :herb:
Tomas: If we make snacks an event, I'm starting a "midnight kitchen mixtape" playlist. short tracks only.
Nadia: love the mixtape idea. bonus: 1-song, 1-snack rules. we'll prototype tonight. :headphones:
Eli: ok adding 'Night Fries Vol. 1' to the playlist. good night, snackers. :crescent_moon:
